meta_data.base_class: Find the profile of an athlete competing in a specific <team-based sport with professional clubs> - refers to a sport with organized leagues and clubs, where players are associated with formal professional teams and can be identified by name.

tool_template.name: find_<class>_athlete
tool_template.description: Find the profile information of a <class> athlete based on their full name.

name.description: The full name of the <class> athlete.

team.description: The team the <class> athlete belongs to.

position.description: The playing position of the <class> athlete within their team.

league.description: The league in which the <class> athlete participates.

active_only.description: Whether to restrict the search to currently active <class> athletes.
